reuse.why: Reuses bank lookup and synchronization helpers and shares validation, completion, and local unlinking, but leaves account-link orchestration copied.

duplication.why: Fintegra duplicates the existing account upgrade/create/import workflow and the transaction-download request/error/response workflow.

placement.why: Handlers, transaction downloading, endpoint configuration, and provider types follow the tree's existing module boundaries.

scope.why: Changes are focused on the requested linking rules, Fintegra integration, and directly related helper extraction.

maintainability.why: Shared rules reduce inconsistent updates, but duplicated provider workflows and an assertion-named helper that unlinks accounts make ownership less straightforward.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use the shared guard and completion helper, and replacement and explicit unlinking share unlinkAccountLocally.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount compresses the existing upgrade/create/import workflow, while downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes downloadEnableBankingTransactions by omitting aspspName and compressing response handling.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and branches for upgradingId, the closed-account check, and replacement refusal; it now performs unlinking as well as validation.
